rankings.summaryHtml: The good news: For the fourth time in the Pop era, San Antonio is the first team to win 40 games. The bad news: Only one of the past seven teams to do so (Boston in 2007-08) reached the NBA Finals. The best news: Tony is playing the best ball of his life ... with or without Timmy and Manu.
